value.rationale: The motivating asymmetric stationary densities lack explicit general formulas. The theorem nonetheless compares every stationary convex observable across arbitrary split kernels ordered in convex order, establishes a strict transform fingerprint and global optimal symmetric fragmentation rule, and gives explicit finite-variance approximation control. This is a structural comparative-statics result, not a small numerical update or rediscovery of known moments.
